text:
Priya: FYI Acme Global wants SOC 2 report, an ISO 27001 scope excerpt, a signed pentest attestation, and proof of key separation for the POC. Target delivery: next Tue. Can we get a minimal bundle together?
Ben: We can push SOC2 PDF + control-matrix CSV today. ISO excerpt is available but needs redaction for customer-specific data. I can handle redaction.
Clara: On the pentest letter: we use a standard vendor sign-off template but legal needs the counterparty name and signatory role. Do we have their point of contact?
Priya: I asked for the signatory yesterday; waiting. Will follow up now.
Dan: Quick ops note: If they require customer-managed keys (CMKs) for backups and snapshot encryption, that's Private-tier. That affects pricing and deployment schedule.
Priya: They mentioned KMS separation and optional HSM. How strict are they likely to be?
Ben: For enterprises, HSM request is common but often optional if we show KMIP/HSM-ready design. We can provide architecture diagram + statement of current KMS flow.
Clara: I'll draft a one-paragraph HSM readiness note. Also include how we isolate tenant keys (KMS key policies + IAM excerpt).
compliance-bot: compliance-bot uploaded: acme-2026-compliance-bundle.zip (presigned link expires in 6 days). :package:
Dan: We need to schedule the external scan window. Ops can do Thu 01:00-04:00 UTC. That avoids peak traffic. @mike-oncall ok?
Priya: Noted. I'll propose Thu window and ask for the signer's full name + email.
Ben: Adding a short how-to for their security team to upload scan results into the dataroom:
```
POST /v1/dataroom/presign
{ "path": "acmeglobal/pentest/2026-03" }
Response: { "url": "https://dataroom.redwood-inference/upload/..", "expires_in": 518400 }
```
Clara: Legal asked to review pentest template. Tagging @legal-review. Also, if they want a signed letter from our third-party vendor we may need 48h for countersign.
Priya: Ok — plan: (1) drop SOC2 + control matrix + redacted ISO excerpt in dataroom now; (2) ask Acme for signer and accept Thu scan window; (3) legal to review pen-test template and confirm countersign timeline; (4) call out CMK/HSM as an add-on in the quote.
Dan: Pricing flag: private-week POC (single-tenant) = estimated $12k/week plus setup. Hosted-with-IP-allowlist option = free POC credits + regular usage charges. Recommend offering hosted first to avoid cost sticker shock, but mention residency caveat.
Priya: I'll present both options clearly. Also noting: if they pick private POC we need 72h lead time for tenant provisioning.
Ben: Uploaded control-matrix.csv and SOC2-attestation.pdf to the bundle.
compliance-bot: compliance-bot: files added -> acme-2026-compliance-bundle.zip (contains SOC2-attestation.pdf, control-matrix.csv, iso-excerpt-redacted.pdf).
Clara: Drafting the pen-test sign-off email now. Will paste template snippet for their security lead to review.
Priya: Great — I'll email Acme with dataroom link, proposed scan window, signer request, and both POC deployment options with pricing/lead-times.
Dan: One last note: include the Ops runbook excerpt for scan coordination and a contact for real-time comms during the window (Slack channel + phone).
Priya: Will do. Sending in ~15. :email:
